<thought>Based on the molecular formula C9H7O4, DBE 7, six aromatic carbons, one methyl group and two carbonyls, the molecule can be viewed as a benzene ring bearing a carbonyl (C=O) substituent and a methyl ester (C(=O)OC) substituent. The two fragments that can be joined to give the full structure are therefore the aromatic carbonyl fragment and the methyl‑ester fragment.</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccc(cc1)C=O', 'C(=O)OC']</final_answer>
